facades.name: Edit
facades.description: Edits one existing UTF-8 workspace file after showing the exact diff for approval.

file_path.description: Workspace-relative path to an existing UTF-8 file

replace_all.description: Replace every exact match instead of requiring exactly one

facades.name: apply_patch
facades.description: The `apply_patch` tool edits one existing file. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.

format.definition:
start: begin update hunk+ end LF?
begin: "*** Begin Patch" LF
update: "*** Update File: " path LF
hunk: "@@" LF hunk_line+
hunk_line: (" " | "-" | "+") line LF
end: "*** End Patch"
path: /[^\r\n]+/
line: /[^\r\n]*/
LF: "\n"

facades.name: Read
facades.description: Reads a UTF-8 text file from the local workspace with stable 1-based line numbers.

file_path.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to read

offset.description: The 1-based line number to start reading from

limit.description: The maximum number of lines to read

facades.name: Read

file_path.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to read

offset.description: The 1-based line number to start reading from

facades.name: Write
facades.description: Creates or overwrites one UTF-8 workspace file with exact content after approval. Overwriting requires a complete Read delivered in an earlier sample; truncated or same-sample reads do not qualify. Missing parent directories are created atomically. Use Edit or apply_patch for partial changes.

file_path.description: Canonical workspace-relative file path (at most 4096 bytes and 64 components)

content.description: Exact UTF-8 file content; empty content is allowed. Input is limited to 1 MiB.
